name: crisismesh-member4-frontend
description: CrisisMesh AI — Member 4 frontend slice: Authority Dashboard (Command Center, Incident Details, Post-Disaster Intelligence). Intended to be merged into the main CrisisMesh React app, not run standalone.
notes: react, react-dom, and firebase are declared as peerDependencies, not dependencies: the main project already installs these (per the tech stack in the project brief), and installing a second copy here would risk two React instances in the same app.
recharts is the one genuinely new dependency this module introduces, for the severity/category/response-time charts.
lucide-react is the second new dependency, an SVG icon set used for the guide's required color+icon+text status pattern (Phase 21) instead of emoji.

Do not run `npm install` for this package in isolation as a way to launch a dev server — there is no build config (Vite/CRA) here by design. See ../INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md: these dependencies are meant to be merged into the main project's existing frontend package.json.

`npm run check` requires esbuild as a devDependency purely for the syntax-check script used during development of this package; the main project's own bundler (Vite/webpack/etc.) supersedes it once integrated.
